name: Continue with TOTP
description: Collects a one-time authenticator code for a known email identity and offers recovery-code, password fallback, and restart navigation.

web.implementation: TOTP verification uses generated AuthClient.createTotpLogin with the password-issued MFA challenge. The canonical recovery-code action routes to auth.continue.recovery, and exit paths clear the challenge.

mobile.implementation: TOTP verification uses AuthContext.signInWithTotpAsync and generated AuthClient.createTotpToken with the in-memory password-issued MFA challenge. The canonical recovery-code action routes to /auth/continue/recovery.

notes: The implementation field id totp is normalized to verification-code.
Validation copy is not used as a stable identifier.
Both supported clients require the short-lived password-issued MFA challenge before TOTP proof can establish a session or token.
Both stable clients consume generated Auth contracts from nuviot/nuvos-app-contracts commit 56f0679a24579937052d7bafb362fa2ef703910a.
